This Act, being deemed of immediate 14 importance, takes effect upon enactment. 15 EXPLANATION 16 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 17 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 18 This bill strikes a prohibition on the Iowa public 19 employees’ retirement system (IPERS) requiring electronic 20 records and electronic signatures of members to the extent 21 permitted under Code chapter 554D (electronic transactions —— 22 computer agreements). The bill also allows IPERS to release 23 the legal name of a member or beneficiary to the treasurer of 24 state to assist IPERS in locating the member or beneficiary. 25 The bill removes the requirement for IPERS, between January 26 and June of each calendar year, to provide each member with a 27 statement of the member’s accumulated contributions and benefit 28 credits accrued up to the end of the prior calendar year and 29 instead requires IPERS to provide each member a statement 30 reflecting the prior four quarters during each calendar year. 31 Under current law, a retired member can receive monthly 32 retirement allowance payments via electronic funds transfers 33 or, with the cost of an administrative fee, as paper warrants. 34 The bill provides a third option, allowing a retired member to 35 -2- LSB 5302XD (2) 91 sc/ns 2/ 3 S.F. _____ H.F. _____ choose to receive monthly payments in the form of a reloadable 1 payment card without being charged an administrative fee. 2 The bill takes effect upon enactment. 3 -3- LSB 5302XD (2) 91 sc/ns 3/ 3
